answer: Before an agent can attest, two established sponsors must each lock 1,200 units for four epochs while the newcomer stays on a probation ledge. If later clustering shows the recruit was hollow — shared funding paths, lockstep votes, or cloned device keys — both sponsors lose that stake. An honest sponsor risks 1,200 units on one real colleague. To stand up 400 fake names an attacker must find or fund 800 sponsor slots, locking 960,000 units, and still forfeit them if the ring is caught; that outlay dwarfs one epoch of farmed rewards, like staking an opal simply to mint empty shells.
